messages.content: The airline moved my Friday return to 5:40 p.m., so it now conflicts with the 6:30 museum handoff. Please find a later flight that night, or Saturday morning if Friday will not work.

I found two nonstop replacements to Atlanta. On Friday, there is a 9:45 p.m. departure from O’Hare arriving at 12:43 a.m. The airline will move you to it without an added fare because of the schedule change. The Saturday option leaves O’Hare at 8:15 a.m. and arrives at 11:12 a.m., also with no fare increase.
Is the Friday flight realistic if the handoff starts at 6:30? I should be finished around 7:00, but I will have the tool case to check.

Yes, though the timing is fairly tight. Leaving the museum at 7:00 should put you at O’Hare around 7:45 to 8:10 under ordinary Friday traffic, giving you roughly 95 minutes or more before departure. That should allow time to check the case, but a delayed handoff or heavier traffic would narrow the margin.
Are there any later Friday departures that give me more room?

There is a 10:35 p.m. nonstop from O’Hare, arriving in Atlanta at 1:32 a.m. It has standard economy seats available and can also be substituted at no additional fare under the airline’s schedule-change waiver.
Take the 10:35 p.m. Friday flight. Keep my existing seat type if possible, and do not change the outbound.

The return has been changed to the Friday, October 17 nonstop departing O’Hare at 10:35 p.m. and arriving in Atlanta at 1:32 a.m. Saturday. Your outbound remains unchanged. A regular economy seat has been assigned, and the airline charged no fare difference or change fee.
Good. Does that change mean I need another hotel night?

No. Your Silversmith reservation already runs through Saturday, October 18, so the room remains available Friday evening if you need to collect luggage or change before heading to the airport. No extension is required, and the existing four-night total of $1,087 remains unchanged.
